sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check online for an easy walk before lunch.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I find two walks and open the help chat.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, I'm comparing the riverside and hill walks.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, what kind of walk would you like?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Something easy, with time to stop for photos.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The riverside walk sounds like a good choice.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The page says flat path, so there aren't any hills?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, it's flat, with seats along the way.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: And the hill walk has steep steps, is that right?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yeah, and the group walks at quite a fast pace.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I compare both options before choosing my walk.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I walk at my own pace on the riverside route?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, it's an audio walk for your phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I won't need to keep up with a group.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly, stop and start whenever you like.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says bring your own headphones, so mine will work?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, use headphones that work with your phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, and is the riverside walk about forty-five minutes long?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it'll take longer with stops for photos.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll choose that one for six pounds.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Good choice, there's a cafe nearby for lunch.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before I pay, I ask where the audio walk starts.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It starts by the library today, not the fountain, if you're coming now.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, where does the walk start today?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: By the library, not the fountain.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The library, got it, and can I start there at eleven?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, you can start any time before five today.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'll save the map on my phone before leaving.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's a good idea, and check your phone's charged too.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll bring my own headphones and walk at my own pace.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're welcome, enjoy your walk and take your time.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've chosen my walk and checked the starting point.
